review_scope: All 745 inventory rows have a recorded triage disposition. Correctness warnings were traced through guards/callers/factories; include, layout, API and harness families were assessed by their specific advisory scope. This is not a proof of whole-solver safety or an assertion that all follow-ups are fixed.

dispositions.paired-self-include: Retain the implementation/header anchor. Each reported file contains only its own include; removing it would discard that standalone header compilation check.
dispositions.direct-dependency-hygiene: Missing direct-provider include advice. The translation unit compiles through transitive dependencies; review and add the owning/public provider in a dedicated include cleanup. This is not a demonstrated runtime defect.
dispositions.guarded-production-optional: Inspected local guards or private caller/factory invariants support engagement; the source-specific rationale records the dependency. No blanket check suppression is proposed.
dispositions.test-precondition-optional: The value is checked by an assertion/fail-fast helper or assumed from deterministic fixture construction. Fixture-only unchecked operator*/operator-> access has an engagement precondition; breaking it can cause undefined behavior rather than a reliable test failure. Add explicit presence checks in those cases. Checked value() access throws on absence.
dispositions.cleanup-exception-contract-followup: The ModelScope destructor and noexcept move assignment call checkpoint restoration. The discovered disabled-proof-array allocation is repaired separately. Explicit invariant throws remain fail-fast; a complete exception-guarantee/failure-injection review remains open.
dispositions.intentional-test-exception-boundary: An uncaught test failure or allocation exception produces a failing test process. These are test mains, not the production main, which catches std::exception.
dispositions.dependency-leak-followup: The analyzer trace ends at a copied std::function capture in CLI11. Source shows the callback transferred into App-owned Option storage; no leak is demonstrated. A fresh ASan/LSan CLI construction/destruction probe supplements review without proving every dependency path leak-free.
dispositions.layout-measurement-candidate: Enum width/padding advice requires containing-record layout and allocation-frequency measurements; changing every underlying type can preserve padding, change public layouts or affect option/bitmask conventions. No automatic narrowing.
dispositions.positional-api-advisory: Adjacent parameters deliberately share a domain or typedef while their names distinguish roles. The warning identifies an API readability risk, not a demonstrated swapped call. Strong wrappers or parameter records are a separate design change.
dispositions.intentional-equal-branches: Inspected switch alternatives intentionally have the same result. Combining labels is optional cleanup; no missing branch operation was identified.
dispositions.bounded-multiplication: The inspected products are bounded: patching reserves 2*constexpr(4), and the tableau test sign factors are +/-1. The diagnosed int multiplication cannot overflow at these sites.
dispositions.assertions-explicitly-enabled: This test file undefines NDEBUG before including cassert, including optimized builds. The assert-contained lit/reason increments are executed.
dispositions.enumerator-guard-correlation: The test probes bounded values 0..63 and casts for round-trip checks only when declared_values marks an actual enumerator. Analyzer loses the pretty-function-derived table correlation; the inspected option enums are scoped/fixed-underlying-type enums.
dispositions.redundant-optional-wrap: An engaged optional clause is dereferenced and wrapped again on return. Return the optional directly after checking caller ownership/copy behavior; this is a cleanup opportunity rather than missing engagement.
dispositions.copy-reduction-candidate: The copied input is read-only in the inspected scope; consider avoiding it after an alias/lifetime review and appropriate verification. No speed claim is made from this diagnostic.
dispositions.ownership-boundary-retained: The by-value parameter participates in an owning builder/callback/forwarding interface. A blanket const-reference replacement is not accepted; inspect the complete signature and mutation/alias contract first.
dispositions.const-payload-copy-candidate: std::move on a const payload copies its vector/model data. The local value can potentially be made non-const and consumed; evaluate this as a separate verified cleanup.
dispositions.trivial-move-style: Moving the scalar-only TrailEntry is equivalent to copying. It introduces no allocation or ownership transfer; optional style cleanup, with no performance claim.
dispositions.copy-only-interface: The receiving CLI/GMP/standard-exception interface takes const references and performs its own copy; std::move does not create a move overload. Removing the misleading cast is cosmetic; reducing the copy requires a different interface.
dispositions.reserve-candidate: Known initial element count permits reserve. Vector append is still amortized linear; any runtime or memory benefit requires measurement. Test-only cases have no solver runtime impact.
dispositions.test-string-cleanup: Single-character find overloads and concatenation advice occur only in test construction/assertions. Optional harness cleanup, no solver performance impact.
dispositions.return-move-candidate: constness prevents moving the optional conflict on return; make the local consumable in a separately verified cleanup.

confirmed_issue.problem: pop unconditionally resized three representative-proof vectors to the checkpoint node count, although ensure_node_count allocates them only for representative ProofForest or explicit proof diagnostics.
confirmed_issue.impact: Unused element storage in one-sided/bidirectional BFS and reoriented/structural proof modes with diagnostics off; first rollback can allocate, including through ModelScope destruction. Three size_t elements per checkpoint node, 24 payload bytes/node on 64-bit builds, plus allocator overhead; no RSS or timing claim.
confirmed_issue.repair: Apply the same mode/diagnostics condition in pop as in ensure_node_count.
confirmed_issue.regression: Nested rollback with post-checkpoint nodes across five modes and both diagnostic settings; disabled representative-proof vector capacities must remain zero and equality rollback must remain correct.
confirmed_issue.verification: Pre-fix-library regression aborts; 45 release and 45 ASan/LSan native tests pass. Qualification records 4200 generated inputs/sessions, 8086 direct Dolmen model checks, and a fresh 132-TU static pass. No speed claim.

open_followups.required_next_step: Review fail-fast invariant exceptions and allocation-failure behavior across checkpoint push/pop and guard construction/destruction. The TR-01 repair is not a blanket no-throw guarantee.
Keep dependency trace/version and separate ASan/LSan CLI scope probe. No confirmed leak; reduce/report upstream if a runtime leak or convincing ownership defect appears.
Review owning/public providers and layer boundaries, then add direct includes in a verified cleanup batch. 225 tool fix suggestions are retained as proposals; none were blindly applied.
Prioritize five copied vector/model payloads behind const std::move and the redundant saved=current copy. Preserve the owning current snapshot. Verify lifetimes and measure before performance claims.

Add explicit presence assertions to fixture-only operator*/operator-> accesses so a broken fixture has a defined failure path. Current fixture assumptions do not guarantee that an absent optional cleanly fails a test.
